synopsis: Autoware documentation provides an open-source implementation of world, vehicle and per-sensor coordinate frames, and requires accurate sensor-to-vehicle installation relationships to correlate sensors [f5412, f5413]. ROS and Autoware also provide open-source examples of bag replay and simulation [f5607]. These references are generic robotics or on-road implementation evidence, not an off-road standard [f5414, f5607]. Chapter 11 reports a 2026 community integration of BeamNG.tech with Autoware and ROS 2 and identifies BeamNG, Autoware and ROS 2 as an explicitly supported tool combination; this establishes tooling availability without resolving the off-road applicability limitation [f8506, f8709, f5414].

relations.note: Adds the sensor-installation accuracy requirement to the coordinate-frame implementation.
Limits the implementation's evidentiary scope to robotics and on-road use, not off-road standards.
The existing 2026 community integration supports the reported tool combination.
Adds a specific 2026 BeamNG.tech integration to the ROS/Autoware simulation examples.
